rationale: This story records a bounded evidence review and dispositions; it makes no code or behavior change. TARGET_ARCHITECTURE.md §21 and TEST_STRATEGY.md §33 treat verification as evidence for the review, not an automatic reason to run broad suites or add tests. No Product Owner clarification is needed to prepare the review.

acceptance_checks.criterion: Perform the bounded review and record evidence, concrete findings, and limitations in Result.
acceptance_checks.expected: Result checks Phase 5 exit criteria against implementation and available evidence across architecture boundaries, duplicate or obsolete paths, documentation drift, relevant tests, performance, security/configuration, and temporary migration structures; each finding includes evidence, impact, and limitations.
acceptance_checks.verification: Inspect Phase 5 completion stories and relevant implementation/test evidence; consult TEST_STRATEGY.md §12 for browser verification limits and §36 for what the default CI gate covers.

acceptance_checks.criterion: Assess findings against Phase 5 scope and identify explicit disposition or destination for each blocking finding and any proposed transfer.
acceptance_checks.expected: Each blocking finding and proposed transfer has an explicit disposition or destination for planner assessment; Phase 9 JavaFX work and already recorded known problems are assessed against their documented scope.
acceptance_checks.verification: Compare findings with docs/ROADMAP.md Phase 5 exit criteria, docs/TARGET_ARCHITECTURE.md §21, and existing authoritative known-problem and story records.

acceptance_checks.criterion: Keep review scope bounded; do not automatically create remediation work or claim milestone completion.
acceptance_checks.expected: Result records findings and limitations only, creates no automatic remediation, and states that milestone closure remains a planner decision.
acceptance_checks.verification: Review Result for scope and disposition; confirm it does not claim Phase 5 closure.

invariants: The health review records evidence and findings; it does not itself close Phase 5.
Only findings supported by evidence are presented as facts; limitations and unknowns remain explicit.
Planned future replacement alone is not evidence of current debt.
Each blocking finding and proposed transfer has an explicit disposition or destination for planner assessment.
The review does not automatically create remediation work.
existing_tests_reviewed: src/test/java and frontend/src/**/__tests__: confirmed existing Java and frontend tests are present; this documentation/review story does not change behavior and does not warrant new tests.
frontend/scripts/*browser-smoke.mjs: browser smoke checks are available but require a browser and running origin per TEST_STRATEGY.md §12.2; use only if a concrete review question requires them.

docs/QUALITY_METRICS.md: reviewed the 2026-10-03 provisional snapshot (Java 58.09% line / 52.72% branch; frontend 92.88% / 85.22%; Python runtime 79.52% / 70.14%; combined 69.51% / 65.86%). Snapshot is dirty-working-tree evidence, not a clean baseline; remote CI status was not verified.

pre_implementation_verification.failure_evidence: No tests were added or run: this review story does not change executable behavior, and broad test execution is not an automatic health-review requirement.

coverage_review: QUALITY_METRICS.md provides only a provisional 2026-10-03 snapshot from a dirty working tree. It reports Java 58.09% line / 52.72% branch, frontend 92.88% / 85.22%, Python runtime 79.52% / 70.14%, and combined 69.51% / 65.86%; clean baseline and remote CI status remain unverified. No current local module report was identified in the review. Use these figures only with their recorded date and limitation; do not infer current coverage.
post_implementation_review_reason: The story itself is the health review. Planner assessment must review its evidence, findings, limitations, and dispositions before deciding whether Phase 5 closure criteria are satisfied.

post_implementation_reviews.reason: The bounded review meets the story’s acceptance criteria and invariants. It assesses Phase 5 exit criteria against implementation and recorded evidence, documents concrete findings with impacts and planner destinations, states limitations, and leaves milestone closure to the planner. No remediation work or milestone-completion claim was added. The NO_TESTS_NEEDED plan is appropriate; targeted checks were run to answer specific coverage questions, and no prepared tests were expected.
evidence: The Result assesses all eight Phase 5 exit criteria and records ten findings (F1–F10), with evidence, impact, and disposition or destination; F1 and F2 are explicitly identified as closure questions.
The Result explicitly says Phase 5 is not closed, records that no product code, tests, or other documents were changed, and explains why broad suites were not run.
The two reported targeted Vitest runs passed: Ecto 19/19 tests and API 8/8 tests. The Result limits these claims to the reported runs and identifies the areas those tests do not cover.

Recorded browser and performance captures are treated as historical evidence, not rerun results; the Result explicitly notes no new performance measurement, live GW2 call, browser run, or remote CI result.
The review’s F1–F10 dispositions address the acceptance requirement to identify blocking findings and proposed transfers for planner assessment.
